dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Water only: one irregular lake in the left half with flat pale blue water fill #BFD5E6 and a thin blue shoreline #2F6DA8, and one winding river, also pale blue fill with thin blue banks, flowing from the lake to the right edge of the image. No contour lines, no roads, no buildings. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
